Resolves #21964
Related: #17692, #20061, #20344, neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1899

Replaces the `32`-PR REST cap and frozen-`base.sha` write fence in `.github/workflows/review-admission-mergeability.yml` with cursor-paginated GraphQL board discovery (`first: 100, after: $cursor`, `CREATED_AT ASC`) verified for distinct-set completeness across all pages, retry-fenced `(headRefOid, refs/heads/dev)` coordinate and active-PR verification around every individual `createCommitStatus` attempt (`actions/github-script` `retries: 0` + per-request `retries: 0`), oldest-eligible (`CREATED_AT ASC`) REST `pulls.get` wakeups charged per physical attempt, latest-observation settlement across same-base head moves and post-`pending` resolutions, and controller-only failure / `pending` holds so non-conflicting PR heads are never painted `error` or `failure` on overflow, rate limits, API errors, or incomplete pages.

- **Change class (`pull-request-workflow.md §3.1`):** `capability` (`feat`). `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline` + `guards` + `unit` run in CI.
- **Decision Record impact:** `none` (`Decision Record: NOT_NEEDED` on #21964 / #17692).
- **Source Discussion:** https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21955 (`[DIVERGENCE_FOLDED @ DC_kwDODSospM4BLlmB]`, `[GRADUATED_TO_TICKET: #21964]`).

Evidence: L4 (hosted GitHub Actions `workflow_dispatch` run `45206390503` on `11e5cf5dfc` + `45177697625` & `45177812168` on `0f6a8a644b` + local Playwright unit replays `89/89` in `ReviewAdmissionMergeability.spec.mjs` & `WorkflowScopeClassifier.spec.mjs`) → L4 required (AC-1..AC-4).
